# OpenCV

> Free online CV builder and cover letter maker. Build a professional, ATS-friendly
> CV or resume from 20+ templates, pair it with a matching cover letter, and
> download a polished A4 PDF in minutes. No design skills required.

## Full documentation
For comprehensive information about OpenCV, including features, templates, CV
writing guidance, technical architecture, and API details, see:
https://opencv.build/llm-full.txt

## Key facts
- **Product:** OpenCV — free CV builder, resume maker and cover letter builder.
- **Templates:** 20+ CV layouts and 7 cover letter styles.
- **ATS:** single-column layouts with standard headings parse cleanly through
  Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS and Taleo.
- **Export:** one-click PDF, DOCX and TXT download; CV + cover letter can be
  exported as a single combined PDF.
- **Created by:** Swadhin Biswas
- **Source:** https://github.com/swadhinbiswas/cv
- **Community:** https://discord.gg/RcfUCUVac

## CV Templates
- ATS Pro — Ultra-parseable single column, safest for applicant tracking
- Classic — Timeless serif for formal industries
- Modern — Clean sans-serif, condensed, scannable
- Minimal — Generous whitespace, dotted rules
- Elegant — Refined centered serif
- Academic — Publication-first CV format
- Technical — Skills-first with keyword chips
- Creative — Bold accent header band
- Executive — Two-column with contact rail
- Sidebar — Tinted side rail
- Two Column — Main left, skills right
- Compact — Tight one-page format
- Ink — Deep indigo serif, small-caps
- Ember — Warm brick-red serif
- Opal — Calm teal, centered
- Harvard — Black serif, framed headings
- ModernCV — Colour-bar section headers
- Sb2nov — Position-first, thin rules
- Engineering — Geometric sans, crisp rules
- Indigo Two-Column — Friendly indigo with skill chips

## Cover Letter Templates
- Classic Block, Modern, Modified Block, Semi-Block, Minimal, Executive, Creative
